derivation:
by
  apply Units.ext; simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, Units.val_mul, hw₀p, Matrix.det_fin_two]
  simp [diagonal2, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
explanation: Applying the 2×2 determinant formula to both matrices reduces the identity to entrywise simplification. The current proof instead uses multiplicativity and det_fin_two_of.
